dust, and protects the wearer from sunlight and cold. It is large and thick
enough to be used as bedding, so it will come in handy when you have no
inn. It has no special effects.>

_original.name: 冒険者の外套
_original.description: 冒険者のために作られた外套。

description: A popular souvenir in the capital of Shikinowa.
name: Autumn Water Haori
note:
<dPlnText:A beautiful haori. A popular souvenir among foreigners.
Although it is a garment made with emphasis on appearance,
it can still withstand use as equipment. It has no special
effects.>

_original.name: 秋水京羽織
_original.description: シキノワの都で人気の土産物。

description: Garments worn by shinobi of the eastern lands.
name: Ninja Garb
note:
<dPlnText:Eastern ninja garb. Combining lightness with durability. The
origin of the ninja attire is unknown, but it is said that
the mystic tanuki of the End hold its secrets. It has no
special effects.>

_original.name: 忍び装束
_original.description: 東国の忍びが纏う衣服。

description: A cloak woven from pure white thread.
name: White Weave Cloak
note:
<dPlnText:Garments seen in Upashimoshiri. A white cloak unstained by
anything. That land is the first resting place of the gods,
and the spun threads sleep beneath the deep snow. It has no
special effects.>

_original.name: 白織りの外套
_original.description: 純白の糸から織られた外套。

description: Armor worn by warriors of the Divine Faction.
name: Adthian Armor
note:
<dPlnText:Armor from Lamrul Aram. Equipment of the Aswad Warriors. It
is crafted for activity in the desert, resistant to heat and
cold, and prevents your feet from sinking into the sand. It
has no special effects.>

_original.name: アドシアンアーマー
_original.description: 神派の戦士が纏う鎧。

description: A monk's robe with an unusual pattern.
name: Monk Robe of a Hundred Eyes
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Monk robes adorned with countless eyes. Worn when entering the defiled
mosquito net. This is the first step toward attaining the essence. It is
said that it has ten thousand eyes. The four-soul anomaly, Nue ― and yet,
no one knows its true form. The following special effects are granted:
・Evasion +5% ・Reduces Earth-attribute damage taken by 20%.>

_original.name: 百々目の僧衣
_original.description: 異様な柄の僧衣。

description: Equipment worn by those practicing Hakutou Style.
name: Hakutou Style Do-gi
note:
<BoostEX:PH, 10>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A do-gi of the Hakutou swordsmanship style
It is plain and suited for actual combat
　
The origins of the Hakutou Style lie with a certain occurrence
Those who aimed for that blade continued their diligent study
Until eventually it became a technique of humans
　
Possesses the following special effects
・Physical attack power +10%>

_original.name: 白刀流道着
_original.description: 白刀流に属する者が着用する装備品。

description: Garments woven solely for protection.
name: Clothing's Protective Garment
note:
<CS_上限TP:0,168>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Pure white garments without defilement. They protect the wearer and their
allies. The spinning worms of the cave were once tools for making clothes,
but at some point they began to spin life and bestow it, and that became
their joy. The following special effects are granted: ・While the wearer is
alive, restores 5% of all allies' HP each turn. ・Attack and Magic Attack
-50%.>

_original.name: 衣の守り服
_original.description: ただ守りのために紡がれた服。

description: A lost item of a monk who walked the Abyss.
name: Warding Robe
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Ritual robes worn by a monk who stepped into the abyss. Possesses the power
to repel the roots of aversion. Dōtoku descended into the valley to
challenge his final good deed. He confronted the origin, realized his own
powerlessness, and yet continued to hold back all evils. The following
special effects are granted: ・Reduces Earth-attribute damage taken by 20%.
・Nullifies Poison.>

_original.name: 厭い除けの法衣
_original.description: 奈落を歩いた僧侶の遺失物。

description: A cloak worn by a fugitive to hide themselves.
name: Fugitive's Cloak
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A grimy cloak. Stained with the colors of the abyss. The eight serpents,
warriors of the clan, for the sake of usurpation, sacrificed all else and
obtained an abhorrent power. That is the child of eight heads, the end
result of the mastermind behind the betrayal. The following special effects
are granted: ・Agility +50%. ・Spirit -50%.>

_original.name: 逃亡者の外套
_original.description: 逃亡者が身を隠すために纏った外套。

description: The attire worn by Yuuyami of the Four-Soul Weird.
name: Yuuyami's Outfit
note:
<BoostEX:EL, 2, 20>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:The costume of the four-soul anomaly, Yūyami. It is also a symbol of the
Ryūya shop. The clothes of the so-called Waya demons are tailored with this
as a reference. The following special effects are granted: ・Fire-attribute
attack power +20%.>

_original.name: 夕闇の衣装
_original.description: 四魂怪異の夕闇が纏う衣装。

description: White vestments worn by the people of the celestial realm.
name: Retal People's Attire
note:
<BoostEX:EL, 8, 20>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Snow-white attire that never gets stained. Making Retaru the
sky of the desert ― that dream never came true. The
following special effects are granted: ・Light-attribute
attack power +20%.>

_original.name: レタルの民の装束
_original.description: 天上の国の民が纏う白装束。

description: Armor made from Orsa's plating.
name: Orsa's Armor
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Specially crafted armor. It acts as an exoskeleton and amplifies the
wearer's power. One of the three survivors ― he gave up being human, and in
doing so, found a way to survive. The following special effects are
granted: ・Attack and Magic Attack +5%.>

_original.name: オルーサの鎧
_original.description: オルーサの装甲で作られた鎧。

description: Garments resembling thin ice.
name: Frozen Light Robe
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Master. It inherits a fragment of that power.
Its regret was that it also buried its friend. What a sorrowful victory
that must have been. The following special effects are granted: ・Critical
rate +3%. ・Nullifies Instant Death.>

_original.name: 凍てついた薄衣
_original.description: 薄氷に似た衣。

description: Clothes worn by a Snow Woman.
name: Winter Hiding Clothes
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the master. Inherits a fragment of that power. In
the inevitable death, she is also salvation. Better to go warm than to go
alone. Has the following special effects: ・Evasion +10% ・Single-target
attack target rate fixed at 0%>

_original.name: 冬隠れの服
_original.description: 雪女が纏う服。

description: Armor made from Abyssal stone.
name: Impermanence Stone Armor
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the master. Inherits a fragment of that power. The
Impermanence Stone is the stone of a dragon that rotted in the Abyss. One
of the traces of the serpent's desecration. Has the following special
effects: ・Non-light elemental damage taken -10% ・Light elemental damage
taken +20%>

_original.name: 無常石の鎧
_original.description: 奈落の石で作られた鎧。

description: Cloth that was wrapped around a desert assassin.
name: Assassin's Bandage
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Equipment obtained from the master. Boasts high performance. The assassin
of the void favored corpse-like attire. Perhaps they were aware that they
were no longer human. Has the following special effects: ・Agility, critical
rate, and evasion +15%>

_original.name: 暗殺者の包帯
_original.description: 砂漠の暗殺者に巻かれていた布。

description: The attire of a miko at Mashiro Shrine.
name: Pure White Miko Attire
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:The shrine maiden attire of Mashiro Shrine. Durable enough to withstand
battles against aberrations. The color of the kimono sleeves is black,
unlike the shrine's name. Only the gods wear white. Has the following
special effects: ・Evasion and magic evasion +10%>

_original.name: 真白巫女装束
_original.description: 真白神社の巫女の衣装。

description: A haori harboring three of the souls among the Shikon Occurrences.
name: Flawed Shikon Haori
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:Woven from the souls of Shikon Occurrences
Inherits a glimpse of their power
　
All three souls are fiercely assertive,
making it difficult for them to maintain harmony as one,
but this one is miraculously balanced
　
Possesses the following special effects:
・Physical and magic damage taken reduced by 8%>

_original.name: 欠けた四魂の羽織
_original.description: 四魂怪異の内、三つの魂を宿す羽織。

description: A haori harboring the souls of the Shikon Occurrences.
name: Shikon Haori
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:Woven from the souls of Shikon Occurrences
Inherits a glimpse of their power
　
While all four souls are fiercely assertive,
they nevertheless maintain harmony.
After all, they are all family.
　
Possesses the following special effects:
・Physical and magic damage taken reduced by 15%>

_original.name: 四魂の羽織
_original.description: 四魂怪異の魂を宿す羽織。

description: The attire of a miko at Mashiro Shrine.
name: Pure White Miko Attire +1
note:
<NameColor:27>
<dPlnText:The shrine maiden attire of Mashiro Shrine. Durable enough to withstand
battles against aberrations. The color of the kimono sleeves is black,
unlike the shrine's name. Only the gods wear white. Has the following
special effects: ・Evasion and magic evasion +15%>

_original.name: 真白巫女装束+1
_original.description: 真白神社の巫女の衣装。

description: A mask modeled after the famous weird, the Oni.
name: Oni Mask
note:
<dPlnText:A decorative piece worn over the face. A craft from an
island nation in the East. Sold as a souvenir, but also a
practical item useful in battle. This mask is different from
the ones of the Shiba group. Has no special effects.>

_original.name: 鬼の面
_original.description: 有名な怪異である鬼を模した面。

description: A mask modeled after the famous weird, the Tanuki.
name: Tanuki Mask
note:
<dPlnText:A decorative piece worn over the face. A craft from an
island nation in the East. Sold as a souvenir, but also a
practical item useful in battle. Has no special effects.>

_original.name: 狸の面
_original.description: 有名な怪異である狸を模した面。

description: A mask modeled after the famous weird, the Fox.
name: Fox Mask
note:
<dPlnText:A decorative piece worn over the face. A craft from an
island nation in the East. Sold as a souvenir, but also a
practical item useful in battle. Has no special effects.>

_original.name: 狐の面
_original.description: 有名な怪異である狐を模した面。

description: A mask said to be modeled after a famous weird.
name: Mysterious Mask
note:
<dPlnText:A decorative piece worn over the face. A craft from an
island nation in the East. Sold as a souvenir, but also a
practical item useful in battle. Has no special effects.>

_original.name: 謎の面
_original.description: 有名な怪異を模したとされる面。

description: A necklace that protects against instant death.
name: Death Guard
note:
<dPlnText:An accessory that prevents status ailments. Physical abnormalities in
battle are called status ailments. They are one of the most common causes
of death for adventurers, so it is essential to take precautions
beforehand. Has the following special effects: ・Instant death nullified>

_original.name: デッドガード
_original.description: 即死から身を守るネックレス。

_original.description: 睡眠から身を守るネックレス。

name: Paralyze Guard
note:

_original.name: パラライズガード
_original.description: 麻痺から身を守るネックレス。

name: Shock Guard
note:
<dPlnText:An accessory that prevents status ailments. Physical abnormalities in
battle are called status ailments. They are one of the most common causes

beforehand. Has the following special effects: ・Stun nullified>

_original.name: ショックガード
_original.description: スタンから身を守るネックレス。

description: An accessory for those who walk the path of hardship.
name: Challenger's Collar
note:
<dPlnText:An accessory made for challengers. It bears a curse, denying
the wearer's combat experience. To remain weak and yet
defeat the strong― perhaps that is someone's wish. Has the
following special effects: ・No experience points gained>

_original.name: 挑戦者の首輪
_original.description: 苦難の道を行く者のための装飾品。

description: A ring imbued with the power of Fire.
name: Ring of Fire Resistance
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A ring imbued with elemental power. It is a treasure born of
nature. Imitation has been sought since the age of myth, but
it was never achieved by human hands. Has the following
special effects: ・Fire damage taken -50%>

_original.name: 耐炎の指輪
_original.description: 炎の力を秘めた指輪。

description: A ring imbued with the power of Thunder.
name: Ring of Lightning Resistance
note:

<dPlnText:A ring imbued with elemental power. It is a treasure born of

special effects: ・Thunder damage taken -50%>

special effects: ・Dark damage taken -50%>

_original.name: 耐闇の指輪
_original.description: 闇の力を秘めた指輪。

description: A ring imbued with the power of all elements.
name: Rainbow Ring
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A ring imbued with elemental power. It is a treasure born of
nature. Imitation has been sought since the age of myth, but
it was never achieved by human hands. Has the following
special effects: ・Non-wave elemental damage taken -30%>

_original.name: 虹色の指輪
_original.description: あらゆる属性の力を秘めた指輪。

description: An amulet carried by adventurers.
name: Adventurer's Charm
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A charm well-known to adventurers. This accessory has a long history; from
ages past, it has been gifted to adventurers since the mythical era.
Everyone prays for the safety of their friends who set out on journeys. Has
the following special effect: ・Reduces the rate of basic status ailments
(excluding Stun) by 50%.>

_original.name: 冒険者のお守り
_original.description: 冒険者が持つお守り。

description: An ornament for praying for good health and safety.
name: Protection Cloth
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A simple cloth ornament. When equipped, it grants a special
blessing, nullifying many status ailments. Has the following
special effect: ・Nullifies basic status ailments (excluding
Stun).>

_original.name: 護り布
_original.description: 無病息災を祈る飾り。

description: A belt for those who stand on the battlefield.
name: War Belt
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A belt suited for those who fight. Lowered stats and losing your balance
both lead to fatal consequences on the battlefield. The stronger one is,
the less they grow arrogant, and they never neglect countermeasures. Has
the following special effects: ・Nullifies Stun ・Nullifies Stat DOWN
・Nullifies Major Stat DOWN>

_original.name: 戦の帯
_original.description: 戦地に身を置く者のためのベルト。

description: A bracelet that surges with vitality.
name: Regen Bangle
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A bracelet imbued with mana power. Even knowing of the
principle of immortality, death is always something to fear.
This kind of equipment is a blessing. Has the following
special effect: ・Recovers 8% HP each turn.>

_original.name: リジェネバングル
_original.description: 生命力が滾る腕輪。

description: A bracelet that brims with spirit energy.
name: Energy Bangle
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A bracelet imbued with mana power. Even the spells and
techniques you've honed and made your own are meaningless if
your energy runs out. This kind of equipment is a blessing.
Has the following special effect: ・Recovers 8% SP each turn.>

_original.name: エナジーバングル
_original.description: 気力が沸き立つ腕輪。

description: A bracelet imbued with battle aura.
name: War God's Bracelet
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A bracelet that carries fighting spirit. In this world, there is no god
called the God of War, nor is there one in Oldwald, either. Perhaps it's a
remnant of the mythical age, or maybe no one knows of it. Has the following
special effect: ・Increases TP by 5 each turn.>

_original.name: 戦神の腕輪
_original.description: 闘気を帯びた腕輪。

description: Magical boots that make you lighter.
name: Dot Eater
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Shoes that make you nimble when worn. Being nimble allows
you to evade attacks. That is certainly not wrong, but the
foundation is always your own ability. Has the following
special effect: ・Increases Evasion by 20%.>

_original.name: ドットイーター
_original.description: 身軽になれる魔法の靴。

description: Boots that allow you to read the flow of magical power.
name: Fairy Step
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Shoes that let you read the flow of mana when worn. Reading the flow allows
you to evade magic. That is certainly not wrong, but the foundation is
always your own ability. Has the following special effect: ・Increases Magic
Evasion by 20%.>

_original.name: フェアリーステップ
_original.description: 魔力の流れを読める靴。

description: A ring made from special thread.
name: Bloodline Thread Ring
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A ring woven from thread, a proof of trust from the bloodline. Kamuy once
forgave the clan they had long shunned, and aimed for coexistence toward an
era of peace. The later betrayal ended in failure, and they escaped to the
bottom of the abyss, to the edge of a rocky cave. Has the following special
effect: ・Increases all stats by 5%.>

_original.name: 血族の糸の輪
_original.description: 特別な糸で作られた指輪。

description: A crown found in the western desert city.
name: Sun-Praising Crown
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A gift for meritorious servants of the divine faction. You
gain the qualification to be seen as a god. To praise the
sun is to live for the gods. Has the following special
effect: ・Reduces SP consumption by 25%.>

_original.name: 太陽を讃える冠
_original.description: 西の砂漠の都市で見られた冠。

description: The robe worn by a strange monk.
name: Skeleton Robe
note:
<BoostEX:EL, 9, 20>
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Master. It inherits a fragment of that power.
The monstrous monk harbors ten thousand eyes in their flesh, and wears a
kasaya stitched from corpses. Has the following special effects: ・Increases
Defense and Magic Defense by 10% ・Increases the power of Dark-attribute
attacks by 20%.>

_original.name: 骸袈裟
_original.description: 怪異僧侶が纏う袈裟。

description: Beads worn by an Oni around its neck.
name: Oni's Beads
note:
<自動蘇生:1>
<蘇生HPレート:10>
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Master. It inherits a fragment of that power.
The Oni's rosary is merely an ornament, but it is said that it can
sometimes harbor the power of the Oni who adorns it. Has the following
